title: fleet-write: a re-run replays writing rows, and the advisory_note door matches git's answer unanchored
body:
domain:skills#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaqHXh17Qc3C7MRAQw

Filing gate: ① tooling hardening with a named producer, raised by the contract review of PR #32556 (#32424): record 6815013623 nit 7 and delta record 6815807297 nit 1. Both are fail-safe today; neither blocks #32556. ⛔ Not a claim; triage decides lane and grade.

## Item 1 — a relay run executed twice writes twice

Nothing stops the same relay request from executing twice: a re-run of a `fleet-write` run replays its actions. For `advisory_note` that appends the section again; every other appending row (comments, issue creation) has the same class. PR #32556's Acceptance notes leave the guard to a follow-up card because it belongs to the relay, not to one row. A request-id idempotency check at the executor (or a refusal of attempt > 1 for writing rows) would close it for every row.

## Item 2 — `advisoryNoteFilePlace` matches git's answer unanchored and locale-bound

`scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs` `advisoryNoteFilePlace` (added by PR #32556) seals a note file only when git answers "not a git repository". The phrase is searched anywhere in stderr, and the probe runs under the inherited locale. A translated git makes an outside file refuse (fail closed); an unrelated failure whose message quotes a path containing that phrase would read as outside. Anchor the match at the start of git's message and run the probe with a fixed `LC_ALL=C`.

## Reach

Item 1: any re-run of a relay run that wrote. Item 2: the seat's `advisory_note` door.

## Duplicate check

Searched open issues for fleet-write re-run / replay and `advisoryNoteFilePlace`: only #32424. No open card.
